criticalChain.identified: Main document→manifest.webmanifest only; no LCP image discovery/resource-load phase

gallery.finding: Starts in static illustration mode with no opacity/reveal animation. The optional3D module is conditional on user activation.

lateOptionalChat.mappedBy: The frozen build react-loadable-manifest maps chunks5910,1620,8713,6930 to LazyChatWidget→ChatWidget.
lateOptionalChat.finding: The entire motion/markdown widget loads at the first idle callback even while closed. These late requests overlap the final observed LCP repaint; this is evidence for an on-demand import experiment, not proof of sole causality.

nextExperiment: Compare a small on-demand chat launcher/full-widget import triggered by actual open, preserving early requests and consent/age behavior; inspect an actual performance trace and repeat identical mobile audits. Separately test font-subset/preload options without losing Finnish/English glyphs. Preserve hydration readiness mitigation and all current functional/no-JS tests.
releaseInterpretation: No speed target pass is claimed. This artifact records an outstanding simulated-mobile render-delay gap; no application source changed during or after these measurements.
